verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is a self-hosted gateway that runs on your own machine. Its memory is plain Markdown in a local workspace (default `~/.openclaw/workspace`), and each agent keeps its own state directory and SQLite session history. You pick the host, Docker environment or per-tenant cell, so storage location is effectively user-chosen. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region documentation, guidance on where prompts sent to chosen LLM providers are processed or stored, independent hands-on corroboration.
